description: This file defines a report for recruitment analytics in an ERP system, including functions to fetch and organize data related to staffing plans, job openings, applicants, and offers.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Returns the column definitions for the recruitment analytics report.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and organizes data for the report based on filters.

methods.name: get_parent_row
methods.description: Generates parent rows for each staffing plan and associated job openings.

methods.name: get_child_row
methods.description: Generates child rows for each job applicant and associated job offers.

methods.name: get_staffing_plan
methods.description: Retrieves staffing plan details from the database based on a date filter.

methods.name: get_job_opening
methods.description: Retrieves job openings linked to staffing plans.

methods.name: get_job_applicant
methods.description: Retrieves job applicants linked to job openings.

methods.name: get_job_offer
methods.description: Retrieves job offers linked to job applicants.
